run_hydra_experiment: run a BenchMARL SMACv2 experiment using Hydra config with the hydra_experiment function
run_experiment_from_cli: run the hydra_experiment entry point via python smacv2_run.py with Hydra CLI overrides
load_experiment_from_hydra: load an Experiment object from a Hydra DictConfig using load_experiment_from_hydra
